capabilities: Sync the browser reading list into a sidebar dashboard panel
Search, filter, and sort items by title, URL, and read state
Open items in the core Web Viewer or the default browser
Read reading lists from Chrome, Edge, Chromium browsers, Safari, and Firefox
Store imported items locally in the plugin's data.json
disambiguation: Does not manage its own to-read list; it only displays the reading list or bookmarks folder your browser already keeps.
extras: Desktop only (macOS, Windows, Linux) because it reads browser data files outside the vault; Safari may require a file-permission grant or Full Disk Access. Fully offline with no network requests or telemetry. It never writes reading-list items into vault notes.
motivation: The author wanted to browse the browser reading list inside Obsidian without turning every item into its own note.
problem: Obsidian has no way to view a browser's reading list, and clipping plugins turn every saved page into its own note, cluttering the vault.

relations.evidence: Selecting an item opens the page as a new tab in the main workspace using the core Web Viewer

requires.name: a supported desktop browser (Chrome, Edge, Chromium-based, Safari, or Firefox)

summary: Browser reading list viewer that syncs Chrome, Edge, Safari, or Firefox reading lists into a searchable sidebar dashboard without creating notes.
